name: 010-product-presets-payment-terms
statements: ALTER TABLE customers ADD COLUMN default_payment_term_days INTEGER CHECK(default_payment_term_days>=0)

CREATE TABLE product_presets(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,organization_id TEXT NOT NULL,description TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(trim(description))>0),unit_price TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(unit_price NOT GLOB '*[^0-9.]*' AND unit_price GLOB '[0-9]*.[0-9][0-9]' AND length(unit_price)-length(replace(unit_price,'.',''))=1),UNIQUE(organization_id,id))STRICT
CREATE INDEX product_presets_organization ON product_presets(organization_id,description COLLATE NOCASE,id)

CREATE TRIGGER invoice_drafts_source_insert BEFORE INSERT ON invoice_drafts WHEN NOT ((NEW.source_app IS NULL AND NEW.source_kind IS NULL AND NEW.source_id IS NULL) OR (NEW.source_app IS NOT NULL AND NEW.source_kind IS NOT NULL AND NEW.source_id IS NOT NULL AND length(NEW.source_app) BETWEEN 1 AND 100 AND length(NEW.source_kind) BETWEEN 1 AND 100 AND length(NEW.source_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 255)) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'invalid draft source');END

CREATE TRIGGER invoice_drafts_source_update BEFORE UPDATE OF source_app,source_kind,source_id ON invoice_drafts WHEN NOT ((NEW.source_app IS NULL AND NEW.source_kind IS NULL AND NEW.source_id IS NULL) OR (NEW.source_app IS NOT NULL AND NEW.source_kind IS NOT NULL AND NEW.source_id IS NOT NULL AND length(NEW.source_app) BETWEEN 1 AND 100 AND length(NEW.source_kind) BETWEEN 1 AND 100 AND length(NEW.source_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 255)) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'invalid draft source');END

CREATE TRIGGER issued_invoices_source_insert BEFORE INSERT ON issued_invoices WHEN NOT ((NEW.source_app IS NULL AND NEW.source_kind IS NULL AND NEW.source_id IS NULL) OR (NEW.source_app IS NOT NULL AND NEW.source_kind IS NOT NULL AND NEW.source_id IS NOT NULL AND length(NEW.source_app) BETWEEN 1 AND 100 AND length(NEW.source_kind) BETWEEN 1 AND 100 AND length(NEW.source_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 255)) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'invalid invoice source');END
CREATE TRIGGER issued_invoices_source_no_update BEFORE UPDATE OF source_app,source_kind,source_id ON issued_invoices BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'issued invoice source is immutable');END

CREATE TRIGGER proformas_source_insert BEFORE INSERT ON proformas WHEN NOT ((NEW.source_app IS NULL AND NEW.source_kind IS NULL AND NEW.source_id IS NULL) OR (NEW.source_app IS NOT NULL AND NEW.source_kind IS NOT NULL AND NEW.source_id IS NOT NULL AND length(NEW.source_app) BETWEEN 1 AND 100 AND length(NEW.source_kind) BETWEEN 1 AND 100 AND length(NEW.source_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 255)) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'invalid proforma source');END
CREATE TRIGGER proformas_source_no_update BEFORE UPDATE OF source_app,source_kind,source_id ON proformas BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'proforma source is immutable');END

CREATE TRIGGER correction_documents_source_insert BEFORE INSERT ON correction_documents WHEN NOT ((NEW.source_app IS NULL AND NEW.source_kind IS NULL AND NEW.source_id IS NULL) OR (NEW.source_app IS NOT NULL AND NEW.source_kind IS NOT NULL AND NEW.source_id IS NOT NULL AND length(NEW.source_app) BETWEEN 1 AND 100 AND length(NEW.source_kind) BETWEEN 1 AND 100 AND length(NEW.source_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 255)) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'invalid correction source');END

CREATE TABLE idempotency_records(organization_id TEXT NOT NULL,idempotency_key TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(idempotency_key) BETWEEN 1 AND 255),operation TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(operation IN('issue_invoice_direct','issue_invoice_from_draft','issue_proforma_direct','issue_proforma_from_draft','issue_invoice_from_proforma','create_correction')),fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(fingerprint)=71 AND substr(fingerprint,1,7)='sha256:' AND substr(fingerprint,8) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),result_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(result_kind IN('invoice','proforma','correction')),result_id TEXT NOT NULL,created_at TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(organization_id,idempotency_key),FOREIGN KEY(organization_id)REFERENCES issuers(organization_id)ON DELETE RESTRICT)STRICT
CREATE INDEX idempotency_records_result ON idempotency_records(organization_id,result_kind,result_id)
CREATE TRIGGER idempotency_records_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON idempotency_records BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'idempotency record is immutable');END
CREATE TRIGGER idempotency_records_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON idempotency_records BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'idempotency record is immutable');END
